verses.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.fr: L''ancien, à Kyria l''élue et à ses enfants, que j''aime dans la vérité, -et ce n''est pas moi seul qui les aime, mais aussi tous ceux qui ont connu la vérité, -
verses.am: በእኛ ስለሚኖርና ከእኛ ጋር ለዘላለም ስለሚሆን እውነት፥

verses.en: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.fr: cause de la vérité qui demeure en nous, et qui sera avec nous pour l''éternité:
verses.am: እኔ ሽማግሌው በእውነት ለምወዳቸውና እኔ ብቻ ሳልሆን እውነትን የሚያውቁ ሁሉ ደግሞ ለሚወዱአቸው ለተመረጠች እመቤትና ለልጆችዋ፤

verses.en: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.fr: que la grâce, la miséricorde et la paix soient avec vous de la part de Dieu le Père et de la part de Jésus-Christ, le Fils du Père, dans la vérité et la charité!
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር አብና ከአብ ልጅ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም በእውነትና በፍቅር ከእኛ ጋር ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.fr: J''ai été fort réjoui de trouver de tes enfants qui marchent dans la vérité, selon le commandement que nous avons reçu du Père.
verses.am: ትእዛዝን ከአብ እንደ ተቀበልን ከልጆችሽ በእውነት የሚሄዱ አንዳንዶችን ስለ አገኘኋቸው እጅግ ደስ ብሎኛል።

verses.en: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, ce que je te demande, Kyria, -non comme te prescrivant un commandement nouveau, mais celui que nous avons eu dès le commencement, -c''est que nous nous aimions les uns les autres.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እመቤት ሆይ፥ እርስ በርሳችን እንድንዋደድ እለምንሻለሁ፤ ይህች ከመጀመሪያ በእኛ ዘንድ የነበረች ትእዛዝ ናት እንጂ አዲስ ትእዛዝን እንደምጽፍልሽ አይደለም።

verses.en: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
verses.fr: Et l''amour consiste à marcher selon ses commandements. C''est là le commandement dans lequel vous devez marcher, comme vous l''avez appris dès le commencement.
verses.am: እንደ ትእዛዛቱም እንሄድ ዘንድ ይህ ፍቅር ነው፤ ከመጀመሪያ እንደ ሰማችሁ፥ በእርስዋ ትሄዱ ዘንድ ትእዛዙ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.fr: Car plusieurs séducteurs sont entrés dans le monde, qui ne confessent point que Jésus-Christ est venu en chair. Celui qui est tel, c''est le séducteur et l''antéchrist.
verses.am: ብዙ አሳቾች ወደ ዓለም ገብተዋልና እነርሱም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በሥጋ እንደ መጣ የማያምኑ ናቸው፤ ይህ አሳቹና የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚው ነው።

verses.en: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.fr: Prenez garde à vous-mêmes, afin que vous ne perdiez pas le fruit de votre travail, mais que vous receviez une pleine récompense.
verses.am: ሙሉ ደመወዝን እንድትቀበሉ እንጂ የሠራችሁትን እንዳታጠፉ ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.fr: Quiconque va plus loin et ne demeure pas dans la doctrine de Christ n''a point Dieu; celui qui demeure dans cette doctrine a le Père et le Fils.
verses.am: ለሚወጣ ሁሉ በክርስቶስም ትምህርት ለማይኖር ሰው አምላክ የለውም፤ በክርስቶስ ትምህርት ለሚኖር አብና ወልድ አሉት።

verses.en: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vient à vous et n''apporte pas cette doctrine, ne le recevez pas dans votre maison, et ne lui dites pas: Salut!
verses.am: ማንም ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ ይህንም ትምህርት ባያመጣ በቤታችሁ አትቀበሉት ሰላምም አትበሉት፤

verses.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.fr: car celui qui lui dit: Salut! participe à ses mauvaises oeuvres.
verses.am: ሰላም የሚለው ሰው በክፉ ሥራው ይካፈላልና።

verses.en: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.fr: Quoique j''eusse beaucoup de choses à vous écrire, je n''ai pas voulu le faire avec le papier et l''encre; mais j''espère aller chez vous, et vous parler bouche à bouche, afin que notre joie soit parfaite.
verses.am: እንድጽፍላችሁ የምፈልገው ብዙ ነገር ሳለኝ በወረቀትና በቀለም ልጽፈው አልወድም፥ ዳሩ ግን ደስታችሁ ፍጹም እንዲሆን ወደ እናንተ ልመጣ አፍ ለአፍም ልናገራችሁ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
verses.fr: Les enfants de ta soeur l''élue te saluent.
